problem: An already completed task scope was displayed as partial/stopped solely from legacy raw run.state, encouraging an unnecessary repeat extraction.

rules: Only explicit task_processing_complete===true on completed/partial terminal states displays task-scope processing complete and pending review.
Failed, interrupted and cancelled states retain their actual outcome even if a stale coverage flag is true.
False or missing/malformed completion flags never infer completion from parser.partial, summary flags, or a raw completed state.
Parser/OCR/structure limitations are displayed separately. Task exclusions such as explicit bibliography alone do not invent parser failure.
Dropdown, progress banner and loaded task-history rows use the same coverage-aware label. Unknown unloaded scopes remain unverified.
Ordinary cancel/review/export/source-integrity controls continue using unchanged raw state and existing guards.

limits: This is task-scope processing completion, not medical approval or full recall.
No full suite or14-step browser rerun; the earlier3047/30-test engineering evidence remains its original checkpoint.
No backend/input runtime pins, medical vocabulary, extraction policy, or paid authorization changed.
formal_review_count: S4 3/3 unchanged; no new formal review
